about: Combinations the next run converts. Edit this list and push to main to (re)run them (an empty list runs nothing); their results replace the old ones for the same model and toolkit in docs/conversion-matrix.md, and every other result is kept. Toolkit = rkllm-toolkit release tag without 'release-v'. also_collect_run_id: results of that earlier run (its uploaded artifacts) are merged in too; null for none.
